name: Basel public car park occupancy (Parkleitsystem)
short: Live free spaces in Basel's public car park garages. Free, no key, CC BY 4.0.
summary: The canton of Basel-Stadt open data portal serves the current occupancy of public car park garages in Basel as a keyless Opendatasoft API: free and total places, share free and occupancy percent, status, address, coordinates, a link to the operator's page and a published timestamp. On 2026-11-08 the dataset held 16 entries (for example Parkhaus City, 1001 of 1114 free) with timestamps a few minutes old.

tasks: free places in a Basel car park now
occupancy percent of Basel's public garages
list Basel car parks with address and coordinates

coverage.notes: 16 public car parks and garages in Basel-Stadt on 2026-11-08.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-08: published timestamps were minutes old; the free count changed between calls.

latency.notes: Per-record published and last_downloaded fields; update interval is not stated.

freshness.notes: Per-record published and last_downloaded fields; update interval is not stated.

licensing.summary: The dataset is licensed CC BY 4.0 per its metadata; reuse including commercial is allowed with attribution to the publisher (Parkhauser Basel-Stadt) and a link to the licence. AI training and resale are not specifically addressed beyond CC BY 4.0 itself.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated systems, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from source to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no imagery in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

time.unknown: How the garage counters are checked is not documented.

location.method: Fixed car park coordinates and address in the record.

content.method: Counts come from the garage operators' systems.
content.unknown: Counting method and error are not documented.

auth.how_to_get: No key sent or needed in the calls made.

endpoints.notes: Current records: title, free, total, auslastung_prozent, status, address, geo_point_2d, published.

api.rate_limits: Not stated in the pages read.
api.notes: Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1; keyless calls answered 200.
